subject: Interview invitation: Senior React Native Engineer
bodyText:
Hi,

Thanks for applying to the Senior React Native Engineer role at Acme Health. The team enjoyed your application and we'd like to invite you to a 45-minute technical interview with our mobile lead.

Please book a slot in the next couple of days using the link below so we can keep things moving:
https://calendly.com/acmehealth-mobile/technical-interview

The interview covers React Native architecture, TypeScript, and a short pairing exercise. No preparation needed beyond your usual setup.

Best,
Priya Shah
Talent Partner, Acme Health

subject: Next steps for Frontend Engineer (React)
bodyText:
Hello,

Thank you for applying for the Frontend Engineer (React) position at Northwind Labs. We'd like to set up a 30-minute introductory call with our hiring manager, Marcus.

Please choose a time that works for you within the next 3 days: https://northwindlabs.com/schedule/fe-intro

Looking forward to speaking with you,
Jordan Lee
Northwind Labs Recruiting

subject: Your application to Initech
bodyText:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your interest in the Software Engineer, Mobile position at Initech. After careful review, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely matches our current needs.

We appreciate the time you invested and encourage you to apply for future openings.

Kind regards,
Initech Talent Acquisition

subject: Following up on the NYC mobile role
bodyText:
Hi there,

Following up on my note from last week about the mobile engineering role with my client, a media company in New York. They're keen to move quickly and the hiring manager liked your React Native background.

Could you send me your updated resume and a couple of times for a quick call this week?

Thanks,
Dana Ruiz
Senior Recruiter, TalentBridge

subject: Northwind Labs take-home assignment
bodyText:
Hi,

Great speaking with you! As discussed, the next step for the Frontend Engineer (React) role is a short take-home assignment: build a small React app that searches and filters a product catalog.

The brief and starter repo are here: https://github.com/northwindlabs/fe-take-home

Please submit your solution within 5 days. Plan for about 3 hours of work.

Best,
Jordan Lee
Northwind Labs

subject: Offer: Senior React Native Engineer at Acme Health
bodyText:
Hi,

Congratulations! Following your final interviews, we're delighted to offer you the Senior React Native Engineer position at Acme Health.

The written offer letter with salary, equity, and benefits details is attached. Please review it and let us know your decision within 4 days. Happy to set up a call with the hiring manager if you have questions.

Warmly,
Priya Shah
Talent Partner, Acme Health
